text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Legal Profession (Mandatory Reporting of Specified Pro Bono Services) Rules 2015 and come into operation on 1 March 2015.

heading.en: Reporting of specified pro bono services
Prescribed requirements for section 25(1)(b)(v) of Act

text.en: 4. For the purposes of section 25(1)(b)(v) of the Act, a solicitor’s application for a practising certificate must be accompanied by a declaration in writing stating that the solicitor has complied with the requirements under rule 3.
